## Clauses

- TS 24.501 5.5.1.2.4 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)
- TS 24.501 5.5.1.2.5 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)
- TS 24.501 5.5.2.2.2 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 titles the clause "UE-initiated de-registration procedure completion - common procedure", "UE-initiated de-registration procedure completion" by V15.7.0; the switch-off sentence is unchanged from V15.0.0 through V19.8.0)
- TS 24.501 Table 10.2.1 T3510 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-16: adds a WB-N1/CE mode value of 85s; the normal value stays 15s; Rel-17: adds 27s for access via a satellite NG-RAN cell; the normal value stays 15s)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-REGISTRATION-DURING-OTHER-RELEASE.md).
